source_to_raster: page_media_width/source_width * render_dpi/72 and corresponding height; preserve float page size and actual raster edge truncation
source_cell_correspondence: Exact row/column/rowspan/colspan; absent matching anchors contribute zero coverage
rounded_crop: floor left/top and ceil right/bottom as PdfLayoutCellOcr; white padding adds no source pixels
tolerance: One original source pixel; separate diagnostic, does not modify bounds or raw overlap
source_sampling: All20 original train images, all1380 anchors/1230 valid published boxes;150 anchors have no source geometry label; no exclusions, crops or annotation repair
